direction.name: 두 색 판화의 빛과 구조
direction.concept: A controlled relief-print composition: deep forest-green lamp structure and warm-light book/page shapes form an interlocking diagonal print rather than a big isolated object on passive field. Show one complete accurate lamp.
direction.image_grammar: Flat ink masses, deliberate directional hatch and crisp plate boundaries; shape rhythms derive from shade curvature and book/page light. No toy mascot or arbitrary print symbols.
direction.body_flow: The complete lamp silhouette and lit paper-plane boundary lead to the title and first description within a connected readable plane. Second description follows in the same text rhythm. A nearby change in the printed plane leads to event/date/place, then visit/bring-book/URL in an adjacent related group. No corner-by-corner sentences.
direction.type: Body in a robust modest-contrast Korean serif with open counters and consistent fine strokes, compatible Latin/numerals. Headline may use cut-ink character but fine body stays precise. Meaningful line wraps; group gap stronger than interline gap.
direction.distinctness: Ink silhouette and intersecting light/page planes actively shape the whole; not photographic sequence or a photograph as main centre.

common_constraints: Prioritize the new skill first-generation body-copy design. Print copy once in a compact positive tool brief, no rubric or whole plan dump.
User product identity and literal copy are authoritative; case-specific direction is implementation guidance, not invented user-fixed coordinates/font/grid.
Every role views its own actual study originals before designing. Study material is not a client asset and is not automatically passed to native generation.
The Canva whole sample is a negative default-template example: take grouping/proximity only, do not repeat its title/date/panel scaffold.
Never read peer makers or quality feedback. Select/close own result before independent evaluation.

assets.kind: synthetic product photograph-style fixture, not real client photograph or a poster

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
